slides.headline: 5 things to check at a viewing
slides.body: Save this for your next one.

slides.headline: Run every tap
slides.body: Check the water pressure and how long the hot water takes.

slides.headline: Look for damp
slides.body: Marks on ceilings, in corners and near windows are worth asking about.

slides.headline: Walk around outside
slides.body: Look up at the roof and gutters, and down at the drainage.

slides.headline: Follow the winter sun
slides.body: Where the sun falls in winter changes how a home feels.

slides.headline: Ask what's included
slides.body: Blinds, light fittings, the pool pump. Get it in writing.

slides.headline: Get The Viewing Checklist
slides.body: Everything to check, room by room, before you make an offer.
